note: One row is one enemy decision point of the production 1v1 turn, in the order VqsvBattleRuntime.selectEnemyAiDecision runs it: source-v1 decide, then BattleAiShadowPlanner.inspect (phase planner, observation, policy projection, candidates, utility ranking, fingerprint), then BattleAiCanaryDecisionAdapter.project for the active runtime mode. The committed decision is the answer the Web port must produce. Skill draws are pinned to the middle of the band so v1 jitter is exactly zero and the switch draw is scripted per row; the v2 controlled jitter is pinned by decisionSeed, so no row depends on which run wrote this file. An enemy whose authored catalog names no PRESET physical trait is pinned to presetPhysicalTraitId because Java would otherwise roll one per run; every row still records the resulting physicalTraitKey. The player is the canonical starter, and rows whose authored encounter is SIMULTANEOUS_2V2 are refused because the 1v1 runtime never routes to them.
